description: Keep avenir-mcp's dependencies current. Minor and patch updates of tooling and the docs site merge themselves once CI passes; everything else, the weekly lock file refresh included, is reviewed by hand.

packageRules.description: Development tools and CI actions move together: one pull request, merged once CI passes.
The documentation site (Astro, Starlight): one grouped pull request, merged once the docs build passes.

fastmcp, the MCP SDK it builds on, httpx and pydantic run in front of users' budgets. Each update is reviewed on its own, and the evaluation is run before merging a fastmcp or mcp update. rangeStrategy is bump, not the default: these ranges are wide enough that a newer release usually already satisfies them, so the default strategy never opens a pull request for one.
Major versions change what the build accepts or how the code behaves: reviewed one at a time.
